Mahbub Islam Mahim

Incoming Research Fellow

Wayne State University · Fall 2026

Hi, I'm Mahbub Islam Mahim. In August 2026, I will join Wayne State University as a Research Fellow, where I will study trustworthy AI and advanced machine learning. Previously, I was a Senior Software Engineer at Samsung Research, where I built knowledge graph and reasoning systems using the RDFox engine in collaboration with Oxford Semantic Technologies, UK.

I completed my BSc and MSc in Computer Science & Engineering at Jahangirnagar University, and was awarded the National Science and Technology Fellowship during my studies. In February 2025, one of my research projects at Samsung earned an A1-grade patent, which I’m especially proud of.
